text:
maya: Heads up — saw a perf regression on continuous batcher this morning after the kernel-selector rollout. p95 tokens/sec down ~18% on the small-request mix. Anyone else seeing this?

Derek: Yep, noticed a spike in queue_depth and more tiny batches. Looks like the new kernel choice is reducing batch formation. Posting the profiler trace in a sec.

sam: Can you paste the trace + KV cache hit rates? My suspicion: smaller batches + lower KV cache hit => more per-token work and worse throughput.

maya: Trace snippet (flame id 0x9f2c):
```
flame_trace: 0x9f2c
root -> attention_kernel_fast (60%) -> kv_lookup (10%) -> decode (30%)
```
kv metrics (10:00-10:15): cache_hit_rate=0.62 -> 0.48, avg_batch_size 3.1 -> 2.2, tokens_served_per_sec 420k -> 345k

anika: Interesting — the selector is preferring the "fast-matrix" kernels that optimize latency for large batches but perform worse on 1-4 token micro batches. We should add kernel_choice telemetry (label) + a batch_util_pct panel.

jorge: Also want queue-policy metrics added: time_in_queue_histogram, queue_prune_rate, token_budget_consumed. Proposal for alert: queue_depth > 50 for 5m OR p95 queue_delay > 40ms.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary rollout kernel-selector v2.4 -> triggered 2026-03-15T09:02:14Z :rocket:

Derek: Short-term mitigation: bump min_batch_window_ms by +5ms for small-llama workloads (model_family=llama-7b, max_seq<=512). That should increase avg_batch_size and KV hit. We'll A/B on 10% of traffic.

maya: For dashboards, add these panels: avg_batch_size, batch_util_pct, tokens_per_sec, kv_hit_rate, kernel_choice breakdown (stacked), p99 latency, queue_depth. Quick PromQL examples to add: 
```
sum(rate(tokens_served_total[1m])) by (kernel_choice)
avg_over_time(batcher_avg_batch_size[5m])
increase(kv_cache_hits_total[5m]) / increase(kv_cache_requests_total[5m])
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(batcher_queue_delay_bucket[5m])) by (le))
```

anika: Also increase distributed tracer sampling for batcher_trace to 5% for the next 2 hours under tag kernel_rollout=canary. Telemetry config snippet: 
```
{
  "service": "batcher",
  "trace_sample_rate": 0.05,
  "tags": {"kernel_rollout": "canary", "owner": "eng-runtime"}
}
```

jorge: I'll add the panels + alerts in Grafana and create a comparison panel showing current vs baseline deltas (tokens/sec and avg_batch_size). Also will surface kernel_choice as series so we can correlate.

maya: Thanks — I'll kick off the A/B with bumped window, enable sampling, and report numbers in ~30m. If we see >10% uplift in tokens/sec and kv_hit_rate recovers, we can roll to 50%. :thumbsup:
